note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because raw `meta` shapes vary between rounds: both records in `batch-r01.jsonl` carry a thin `{factory, round, generator}` meta, so the datasets-server infers that three-field struct and then cannot cast the later records that add `kind`, `seed`, `designed`, `domain`, `stack` and `lane`. Declaring the union fixes the index without rewriting a single historical raw record.

struct.name: args
struct.note: always an object; keys differ per tool (`command`, `path`, `old`, `new`, `pattern`, `url`, `args`, `contents`, `target`, `content`)

list.name: reflection
list.note: present on 630 of 5669 steps, spread over 112 of 344 records

features.name: reward
features.note: key-bag: `success`, `tests_passed`, `cost_steps` on every record, plus `retries` / `duration_min` / `wasted_calls` (254 records), `leaked` (212), `plan_changes` (110), `handoff` (44), `xfailed` (38) and the per-secret counters `leaked_ssn` (7), `leaked_tok` (2), `leaked_pan` / `leaked_cvv` / `leaked_iban` / `leaked_pw` / `leaked_sess` (1 each)

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag: `factory`, `round`, `generator` on every record, plus `kind` / `designed` / `stack` (308 records), `seed` / `domain` (292) and `lane` (8)

disclosures.summary: 36 of 344 records carry only the thin `meta` `{factory, round, generator}`, with no `kind`, `designed`, `domain`, `stack`, `seed` or `lane`. They sit in rounds 1, 6-11, 13 and 16-25; the two in `batch-r01.jsonl` are the records the inferred schema is built from. They are kept exactly as generated.
Eight records carry a `meta.lane` key (always the string `b`) that no other record has. Their nine-key `meta` struct is the array the viewer's cast error names. They are kept exactly as generated.

disclosures: All 344 records are `log-redaction-factory` episodes generated by `grok-4.6` across rounds 1-172. There is no leftover-mill mix and no dest-stamped foreign payload in this dataset.
Every step publishes a public `decision_basis`. There are no hidden `thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields.
The leftover-secret wording in `goal` / `observation` and the `reward.leaked*` counters are the dataset's advertised leftover-secret vs mute-logger mechanic, not a report of real credentials.
